phase_name: Redeploy and discharge the full gate set

objectives.description: Run deploy-headless.sh to regenerate the deployed .claude/ tree
Confirm deployed copies of the five edited files carry this plan's changes
Discharge full verification tier per the dispatch's own Batch Gate Deferral section
Record in the issue log whether the deferral directive was present and which invocation was run

deviations.reason: deploy-headless.sh's default mode runs an inline verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow (the full 42-check aggregator) unless --skip-verify is passed. The first Phase 5 call omitted that flag, triggering exactly the full-aggregator-under-contention risk this task's subject matter exists to prevent -- a self-referential miss, caught and logged via issue-record.sh. Corrected on the second deploy call (--skip-verify), followed by the dispatch's own named scoped narrowing (run-all.sh --only <9 suites>) instead.
deviations.annotation: noted inline in the plan checklist and in the phase-5 handoff

notes: Diff confirms all five edited files are byte-identical deployed vs source-store. test-orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh passed 201/0 on the deployed tree. Two suites in the named 9-suite selector (test-orchestrate-build-aux-dispatch.sh, test-orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh) failed for reasons confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to any file this task touched (a manifest-routing model-resolution issue unrelated to reviser-agent.md's frontmatter, and the same missing-lib-script sandbox defect already logged in Phase 1). A composed dispatch built from the DEPLOYED composer confirms ## Batch Gate Deferral sits between ## Description and ## Artifact Round/## Plan.
